title: 新版节目不署名  (Declining to Put His Name on the Credits)

segments.t: At the joint network review meeting, Qin Xiao conveys DTS's high praise for Unit One's revamp proposal and announces Wen Simo as host, before suggesting Chun Yuqiao share producer credits with Unit Two's head. Listen to Qin Xiao, Xingzi, and Kaiwen in Mandarin first.
新版的文娱论完全符合台里面的要求，你们提交的方案十分精彩。
这份方案是按照淳于总几周前的实际改版总结出来的。
只不过淳于总现在病着，最终文本还没有给他过目。
我们心里本来还觉得不太稳妥呢。
已经十分稳妥了，淳于总果然厉害，你们总编室也真是能干。
这次我们台里请出了镇台之宝，由闻思默老师担任节目主持。
从这一点就能看出台里面的重视程度了。
今天请大家来，还想讨论一下关于共同制作这件事情。
这档节目我们还是希望淳于总和孙总共同制作，不知道意下如何？
在这件事上，我们淳于总有些不同的意见。
凯文，你说吧。
淳于总交代过了，他从来不习惯跟别人联合制作。
所以新版的文娱论，他不准备署名。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
新版的文娱论完全符合台里面的要求，你们提交的方案十分精彩。
'The revamped Entertainment Talk fully meets network standards, and the proposal you submitted is brilliant.'
这份方案是按照淳于总几周前的实际改版总结出来的。
'This proposal was summarised from the actual revamp Mr Chun Yuqiao carried out weeks ago.'
只不过淳于总现在病着，最终文本还没有给他过目。
'It is only that Mr Chun Yuqiao is ill right now, so he has not reviewed the final text yet.'
我们心里本来还觉得不太稳妥呢。
'We were actually worried it might not be solid enough yet.'
已经十分稳妥了，淳于总果然厉害，你们总编室也真是能干。
'It is thoroughly solid — Mr Chun Yuqiao truly lives up to his name, and your office is capable indeed.'
这次我们台里请出了镇台之宝，由闻思默老师担任节目主持。
'This time our network brought out its crown-jewel host, assigning Wen Simo to present the show.'
从这一点就能看出台里面的重视程度了。
'From that alone, you can see just how highly the network values this programme.'
今天请大家来，还想讨论一下关于共同制作这件事情。
'We also invited everyone today to discuss co-producing the programme.'
这档节目我们还是希望淳于总和孙总共同制作，不知道意下如何？
'We still hope Mr Chun Yuqiao and Mr Sun will co-produce this show — what do you think?'
在这件事上，我们淳于总有些不同的意见。
'On this point, Mr Chun Yuqiao holds a somewhat different view.'
凯文，你说吧。
'Go ahead and tell us, Kaiwen.'
淳于总交代过了，他从来不习惯跟别人联合制作。
'Mr Chun Yuqiao left clear instructions: he has never been accustomed to joint production.'
所以新版的文娱论，他不准备署名。
'Therefore, on the revamped Entertainment Talk, he does not plan to put his name in the credits.'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

淳于总交代过了，他从来不习惯跟别人联合制作。
所以新版的文娱论，他不准备署名。
True to his principles, Chun Yuqiao gives up on-screen credit altogether rather than share a watered-down title, closing Episode 7 on a decisive note. See you next time!
